title: The Mislabeled Jar
objective: The right answer gets the tea off sale with care and evidence while the merchant saves face, treating Senna’s expertise as real.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Pim skids up, waving a paper packet. On the front, a beaming old woman in a nightcap promises sleep.

intro.speaker: PIM
intro.text: “Senna! Gran bought this! *Grandmother’s Sleep Tea!* It’s got grandmother on it, so it’s safe, isn’t it? Can I have some?”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna takes the packet and tweezes one gray-green leaf out of it. Then she goes very still.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Pim. Where did your gran buy this?”

intro.speaker: PIM
intro.text: “The market! There’s a queue! The man says it’s outselling honey!”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna takes your sleeve and tows you, without explanation, to a market stall in the Town Square.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A queue of yawning customers leads up to the stall. The merchant is scooping tea from a big jar labeled *GRANDMOTHER’S SLEEP TEA*.

intro.speaker: MERCHANT
intro.text: “One at a time, plenty for everyone! Princess! A big bag for you?”

intro.speaker: MERCHANT
intro.text: “Stop? It’s my own grandmother’s recipe! Chamomile, lime flower, mullein. She drank it for ninety years!”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “The chamomile’s fine. The lime flower’s fine. This isn’t mullein.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “*Digitalis purpurea*. Foxglove. Before it flowers, the leaves pass for mullein, if you’re in a hurry and you squint. Somebody squinted.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “In a teapot, it makes the heart trip over its own feet.”

intro.speaker: MERCHANT
intro.text: “Foxglove? I buy from a proper supplier! He has a cart! With his name painted on it!”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “A cart with his name on it. That’s basically a certification.”

intro.speaker: MERCHANT
intro.text: “With respect, Princess, you’ve looked at one leaf. One! I’ve got a living to make.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna looks at you. Both her hands are full of evidence, and the queue is still moving.

options.labelText: “Let’s report it to the guard tomorrow. No need to make a scene in front of everyone.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: At the front of the queue, a woman buys two bags. One’s for her mother.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Senna climbs onto a crate and explains foxglove to the entire queue, loudly. The merchant hides behind his jar.

options.labelText: “Let’s check it against your herbal, right here. Can the sale wait five minutes while we look?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “If she’s wrong, I’ll buy the first ten bags myself.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You slide her herbal out from under her arm and find *Digitalis*. You hold the leaf against the drawing while she points.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Turn it over. The veins make a net, and the edge has little teeth. Mullein’s smooth at the edge and woolly as a sock.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The merchant looks at the drawing, then at the leaf. His face goes the color of weak tea.

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Your supplier swapped the leaf. Anyone could’ve missed it.”

branch.speaker: MERCHANT
branch.text: “Anyone could’ve! Right! Sleep Tea’s off, everyone! Refunds at the front, and a free honey cake each!”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Nobody eat the honey cake until I’ve looked at it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She relabels the jar *EVIDENCE*. Then she inspects a honey cake. It passes, and Pim gets the first one.

options.labelText: “Senna, come on. You think everything’s poison.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I think this is foxglove. I think you’re standing in front of the queue.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She steps around you and opens her herbal for the merchant. She doesn’t show it to you.
